org.name: Camden and Islington NHS Foundation Trust

hazard: Lack of timely crisis team visits and communication
theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Mark Daniels
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: Following the inquest into the death of Mr Daniels you noted the following failures by the Crisis team: to visit Mr Daniels twice a day despite a plan to do so; to record why twice daily visits were not attempted; to communicate within the team and with the two Crisis houses; to consider hospital admission despite the fact that Mr Daniels was known to have made several suicide attempts; had told staff he did not feel safe at home; was observed to be keeping a rope at home; told staff he would kill
promises.summary: Implement comprehensive action plan to address crisis team failures

concerns.quote: the crisis team: - to visit Mr Daniels twice a day, despite a plan so to do; - to record why twice daily visits were not attempted; - to communicate within the team and with the two crisis houses; - to progress the referral to a crisis house promptly; - to consider hospital admission, despite the fact that Mr Daniels was known to have made several suicide attempts; had told staff he did not feel safe at home; was observed to be keeping a rope at home; told staff he would kill himself, albeit not
concerns.hazard: lack of timely crisis team visits and communication

concerns.quote: lack of cohesion and clinical direction
risk that future deaths will occur unless action is taken

reports.title: Jonathan Meaney
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: we have asked to be provided with copies of CANDI's finalised Serious Incident investigation report and response to your Prevention of Future Deaths Report, to ensure that any opportunities for learning within this Trust are captured and shared appropriately
promises.summary: request copies of CANDI's finalised Serious Incident investigation report and response

promises.quote: The nurse in question was an agency professional, employed by NHS Professionals. (NHSP). tn light of this case, he has been suspended from working at this level of expertise until the serious incident review has been completed.
promises.summary: Suspend agency nurse pending serious incident review

concerns.quote: Mr Meaney waited in the emergency unit for 40 hours and so it was unsurprising that he was then keen to go home
When the mental nurse assessed Mr Meaney before discharge on Wednesday, 15 March, he did not question Mr [name redacted] assertion that he had not intended to take an overdose two days before

The mental health nurse assessed Mr Meaney as rational and having good insight, despite the fact that Mr Meaney once again (as he had done repeatedly for many months) raised a physical problem for which no organic cause had been found.
concerns.hazard: misattribution of physical symptoms to mental illness

concerns.quote: The mental health nurse did not consult any other member of the team before clearing Mr Meaney as fit for discharge from a mental health point of view
concerns.hazard: lack of multidisciplinary consultation before discharge

concerns.quote: who saw Mr Meaney decided to refer Mr Meaney to his general practitioner for counselling, though Mr Meaney had already said that he had not found the crisis team helpful.
concerns.hazard: unfulfilled referral to GP for counselling
